run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the square root of a number using the Babylonian method
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled by comparing absolute results within a tolerance of 0.001
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the Babylonian method with a different square root algorithm
review_f_gold: review f_gold which iteratively converges on the square root using x and y variables
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that calculates square root via repeated averaging of x and n/x
